cc:Work.dc:title: Duality overview
cc:Work.dc:description: Conceptual overview redrawn from Alex Kaltenbach’s Duality_overview.png. Duality connects a priori error analysis (blue), a posteriori error analysis (orange), and iterative solvers (purple). Original directional cycle and exact source palette retained; slide header/footer omitted.
